revision: rev01 pass 2 (revision brief: FEEDBACK.md). Proposals from FEEDBACK.md are the working defaults here: 7 bank poses on 31x33 with pivot (15,16); pose transitions of 40-65 ms; plasma charges while fire is held, about 0.9 s to full, releasing early fires nothing; nova 12 frames / 620 ms; 17 plasma effect frames; 7 flash counterparts; the proposed projectile sizes. Each is marked "proposal" where it appears. Gate 1 (owner, 24 Oct 2026): studies approved as stills; player candidate N1, round hostile orb, needle pre-baked at 0/22.5/45 degrees, nova stored as a sparse tile atlas by the consumer. Gate 2 (owner, 24 Oct 2026): Phase 2 assets approved as stills; nova staging kept. Gate 3 (owner, 24 Oct 2026): Phase 3 assets and background tweaks approved as stills; the pass is complete. Completion pass (gate 4, approved by the owner 24 Oct 2026 as stills + GIFs): Kiln death states, player death, reduced-motion cue sprites, mine and pickup sprites, beam warning marker, motion review fixes. Entries added in this pass carry 'pass': 'gate 4'. Gate-4 decisions (24 Oct 2026, delegated by the owner): nova fade-3 dropped from playback, fade-2 kept; beam lanes 15 / 13 px at 640; mine radius 6. Presentation pass (gate 5, approved by the owner 24 Oct 2026 as stills, including the ringed charge-ready static, low hull at hull <= 1 and the 2.6 s stage card): HUD, 5x7 font, charge/boss bars, pause/options, stage cards, result plates; entries carry 'pass': 'gate 5' and the top-level 'presentation' section holds layout, layer order and text colours.

conventions.units: pixels in the 640x360 logical view; 1 texel = 1 logical pixel, no runtime scaling
conventions.origin: top-left of each canvas, +x right, +y down
conventions.pivot: canvas pixel the game position maps to; sockets are offsets from the pivot, +y down
conventions.canvas: odd width and odd height, so a symmetric ship has a 1 px centre column and the pivot sits on a whole pixel (also after the engine's -90 degree rotation of the Kiln parts); backgrounds are exempt
conventions.alpha: binary: palette index 0 is transparent, every other pixel fully opaque
conventions.frames: one full palette-index grid per frame (baked frames), stored as a horizontal strip PNG, frames left to right in 'frames' order; a sprite with 'canvases' lists one canvas per frame instead of one shared 'canvas'
conventions.sockets: a socket is [dx, dy] from the pivot, a list of them, or an object keyed by frame name when it moves per pose; a per-pose socket must be given for every frame
conventions.bounds: 'damage' is the collision shape the game may use (circle radius from the pivot, or a rect [w, h] centred on it); 'glow' is the decorative extent that promises no damage
conventions.muzzles: a muzzle socket is the first transparent pixel straight ahead of the muzzle centre (the pixel a shot is spawned on); exhaust sockets are the centre of the nozzle exit on the row below it
conventions.edges: no opaque pixel on a canvas edge row or column, except where the canvas is exactly the sprite's shape (primaryLance 3x11, hostileNeedle head columns)
conventions.edgeClear: sprites with "edgeClear": true must keep every opaque pixel off the canvas edge rows and columns (validate.py checks it); hulls that fill their canvas omit the flag

viewport.presentation: integer scale k = floor(min(screenW / 640, screenH / 360)) in device pixels; the remainder is letterbox/pillarbox in the clear colour
viewport.smallWindowPolicy: if the formula gives k = 0 (viewport smaller than 640x360 device pixels) use k = 1, centre the 640x360 canvas and let the viewport clip it equally on both sides; never scale by a fraction, so the pixel grid stays whole. Such windows are not a supported play target.

optionalTallMode.use: 16:10 screens only; the extra 40 rows hold background and HUD, never playfield

palette.note: One shared indexed palette. Ramps are contiguous and ordered dark -> light. Index 0 is transparent. Indices 1-55 are the original hull and environment ramps and are never recoloured; 56-76 are effect ramps added for the projectile, plasma and nova vocabulary. 77-83 (panel, alert) are the presentation ramps added at gate 5 because ui's 3 text entries cannot also carry plates, tracks and danger.

sprites.directions: frames point down (+y) rotated 0, 22.5 and 45 degrees clockwise on screen (tip swings from straight down toward -x). The 16 directions are angle = k*90 + {0, 22.5, 45, 67.5} degrees: frames needle-0, needle-22, needle-45 and needle-22 mirrored across the down-left diagonal (PIL TRANSVERSE), each then turned k quarter turns clockwise. Colours are symmetric, so mirroring flips no lighting. Centre of mass of every frame is on the pivot.

radii.note: proposal: outer ring radius per frame, px from the origin. Canvas = 2R+3 for ignite/expand frames (1 px margin) and 2(R+12)+1 for fade frames (embers drift up to 10 px outward). Band width: 4 px at r10, 5 at r40, 8 at r110, 9 from r200 on, as 1 px white front + 1-2 yellow + gold body + 1-2 orange, with inner tabs up to 3 px (study C)
radii.derivation: farthest visible corner from any legal player position: player clamp [24..616]x[57..319] in the 640x360 view (the 480x270 clamp scaled by 4/3); the worst case is a low origin to a top corner, (24,319) to (640,0) = 693.7 px, so fade-2 (r695) is the corner-reach frame
radii.staging: re-staged after Phase 2 build 1: from the screen centre the farthest visible point is ~406 px, so the coherent ring now ends at r410 (expand-5) and thinning starts on screen; the corner reach (690) falls on fade-2, so fade-2 keeps ~40% of the circumference with its front intact on the kept arcs. Trade-off recorded for gate 2: from a central origin the farthest visible point is ~406-452 px, so the fade frames (r500+) are seen only when the player is near an edge or corner; thinning from r300-400 would show dissipation in normal play but weaken the corner reach

sprites.integration: chain check (Phase 3, stills): at a fixed 45 px joint spacing there is no gap or overlap, with 10-11 px (head to segment 1) and 22 px (segment to segment) of bare code link. The game's phase-lag term makes the spacing 27-63 px at 640: at 27 px segment 1 overlaps the head's rear stack by 7 px, which no art compression can absorb; at 63 px the chain reads as beads on a rope. Consumer fix: keep the minimum spacing >= 34 px (e.g. base 52 with a +-18 lag) or cap the lag term, and draw the head above the segments. After the -90 degree rotation the drill points screen +x (the head leads to the right), matching the game's trailing segments at x - 34(i+1).

sprites.role: 9-slice panel for pause, settings, controls and result screens; light from the top (top edge one step lighter than the bottom)
3-slice divider under a panel title

on/off switch for SOUND and REDUCED MOTION; on/off differ in knob position and fill, readable in greyscale
4-cell volume meter for MUSIC and EFFECTS (0, 25, 50, 75, 100)

stage title card: frame + authored large stage numeral (1/2/3) + one motif per stage in a muted ramp (Breakwater navy, Furnace rust, Citadel engine); the stage name and 'SECTOR 0n' are drawn by code in the 5x7 font into the text slots

sprites.design: as built (gate 5): 5 px chamfered plate with a 3 px inset engraved frame; title rows 16..26 + shadow row 27, centred on column 150 (even widths sit half a pixel left); accent rule on row 21 ending in diamonds at x 14 and 286: sector-secured one nova diamond per side, campaign-complete three, signal-lost a dashed alert rule (4 on, 3 off) with hollow diamonds

displayFace.widths: 9 px; E, L 8; T, Y 10; I 2

displayFace.glyphs: A C D E G H I K L N O R S T U Y (only those the three titles use)

sprites.measuredColors: 12 over the strip (9/9/7 per frame); outline unused

codeDrawn.note: Code rendering stays allowed. Projectiles now have authored sprites above (primaryLance, hostileBead, hostileNeedle, hostileOrb, plasmaShot); the renderer may draw them from those sprites or reproduce them with rects using the same ramp colours, as long as shape and size match. Shape is assigned to behaviour consistently (one shape per weapon role), never picked per shot. Dangerous cores sit above hulls, smoke and debris; trails are subordinate to the core.

beamLane.role: stable bright lane with a distinct pre-fire warning
beamLane.width: follows the agreed collision geometry (beam.width in the game); art adds no width

firing.separation: orb[0], 1 px each edge, inside the width
firing.pulse: orb[3] 6-row marks on the body/core boundary every 32 rows, scrolling down (proposal)

warning.boundary: orb[2] at 75%, dashed 6 on / 4 off, scrolling
warning.marker: two stacked 11x7 down-triangles at the emitter end, orb[0] rim, upper orb[2], lower orb[3], blinking (gate 4: sprite beamWarning)

beamLane.proposal: study B colour table; opacities to confirm in play

widthsAt640.decision: decided 24 Oct 2026 (owner delegated to the orchestrator): odd widths so the lane centres on the odd 13 px beamWarning marker and its 1 px centre column; rounded down from 16 and 13.3 so a beam is never stricter than today at x4/3. Replaces spawnBeam widths 12 and 10.

readyCue.role: on-ship charge-ready cue: the plasmaReady pulse at the muzzle plus a 1 px plasma[3] rim on the prow; HUD charge bar is the consumer's

lowHullCue.role: persistent low-hull warning: a 2x2 needle[1] emissive on each pod rear (rows 21-25 of the player canvas, on the aft section above the collar), blinking at ~2 Hz; separate from the damage flash

gameplay.note: Proposals. All world constants scale by 4/3 so timing and screen-relative speeds stay as they are; collision radii follow the new sprite sizes. The plasma damage, cooldown/resource cost and boss interaction are design decisions to settle in play.

plasma.release: full charge only; early release fires nothing; primary fire keeps running while held

gameplay.mineRadiusDecision: decided 24 Oct 2026 (owner delegated to the orchestrator): 6, the diamond half-diagonal, so contact damage never comes from empty canvas corners (the radius also sets player contact via combat-collision.ts); shooting the mine stays easy with the bullet radius added

presentation.note: Gate 5 presentation pass. Coordinates are in the 640x360 view, x/y of the top-left pixel, inclusive ranges. Layout numbers are working values; agents report measured ones and the orchestrator writes them.
presentation.textRule: One pixel density: all text is the 5x7 font at 1x. Never scale text or sprites at runtime; large words (result titles) and numerals (stage cards) are authored inside their plates.

font.case: upper only; the consumer upper-cases input
font.drawing: the strip is ui[2]; the consumer uses opaque pixels as a mask and draws them in the text colour it needs (textColors)

bands.playfield: player clamp y 57..319 (pivot); hull bottom row 335 stays above the bottom band; the exhaust tail passes under it (HUD layer above exhaust)

hullPips.note: x/y are each pip's top-left; every HUD and screen sprite has pivot (0,0)

controlsHint.text: SPACE/MOUSE FIRE   B NOVA   ESC PAUSE (37 chars, 221 px)

plates.rule: left cap at the plate's first column, fill repeated, right cap ending at its last column; rows from plateRows

banner.width: textWidth + 22 (11 px each side): caps 9 px + fill (width - 18)
banner.variants: normal caps for stage/sector text, alert caps for PHASE banners
banner.replaces: the centre banner rect + text in combat-render.ts

layout.scorePops: font at 1x in scorePop colour, no plate

layers.order: bottom to top; the consumer maps these to its layer numbers
list: hulls: enemies, bosses and parts, mines, pickups, player exhaust, player, playerFlash, playerCalm
effects: explosions, hit sparks, debris, breakups, plasma charge/ready/muzzle at the player muzzle
HUD: bands, plates, bars, HUD text, centre banner, stage card, score pops
beam lanes (warning and firing) and beamWarning marker
bullets: primaryLance, plasmaShot + trail, hostileBead, hostileNeedle, hostileOrb, plasmaImpact
pause / result scene: dim overlay, panels, text
rules: bullets, beam lanes and the player core are never under the HUD, the banner or the stage card
hulls may pass under the HUD bands, banner and card (they enter from above the top band)
the nova ring passes over the HUD but under lanes and bullets, so it never hides a threat
HUD saturation stays below the gameplay layer: plates and text use panel/ui/alert; cue fills use their gameplay ramp's lower entries, with the light entries only for ready/low states

dim.note: over the frozen stage for pause and result

panel.height: 40 + 19 * items; controls page 40 + 19 + 11 * lines + 4; result panel 23 + 11 * statLines + 19 * items

panel.top: 180 - floor(height / 2) (even heights sit half a row high)

settings.title: SETTINGS

controls.title: FLIGHT CONTROLS
controls.note: gate 5 as built: lineX matches the settings label column; +4 rows before BACK

footer.color: label (ui[0]); the dim overlay counts as a band, so the footer needs no plate (panel[3] was too weak)

integration: click hit areas become the item rects (x 216..424, rows itemTop..itemTop+14), for press and drag start
page titles are 1x heading text; result titles move into resultPlate (no scale-2 text)
controls hitbox line uses heading ui[2] (today 0xbaffdb is outside the palette)
dim is panel[0] at 0.85; item plates are opaque sprites
disabled item state is unused today
the title screen (kind title) is outside this pass; its items also need the new rects

lowHull.cue: hudPip low-a/low-b on the remaining pip(s), hullLabel in danger colour; matches codeDrawn.lowHullCue (needle[1], ~2 Hz)

reducedMotion.rule: nothing in the HUD or screens blinks; each looping cue has a static counterpart in hudCalm

presentation.stageStart: the card needs its own 2.6 s timer and the stage-start banner suppressed while it shows (stage.ts sets run.banner = stage.name, bannerTime 3.5); slot text SECTOR 0n uses index + 1; frames are picked by stage id (they match stages.ts ids)
integration: layer order: combat-render.ts draws the HUD on layers 40-46 above bullets (13-16) and the nova (17); presentation.layers needs HUD < nova < lanes < bullets < core; bands become opaque (today 0.92)
RunState has no plasma charge field yet, so chargeBar has no data (hold-to-charge is not implemented)
no low-hull state in code (threshold hull <= 1 is a proposal); pips are still 7x5 rects
banners need a kind (stage/sector vs PHASE) to pick the alert plate and danger text; today colour is chosen from run.phase and seconds
the Gatebreaker enrages at hp/2 but never sets bossPhase or a banner; its 0.5 mark is its only phase cue
boss name x becomes 320 - floor((6n-1)/2); Kiln (<hp/2) and Engine (<hp/3, <2hp/3) thresholds match the marks
bars: draw the track, then columns [0, ceil(w * fraction)) of the fill frame
